bear.rationale: 价格回落及同业扩产使营收低于Q2年化水平，经营利润率回落至25–30%；周期性和较低增长给予12–14倍正常化税后利润。不是已发生事实。

base.rationale: 收入围绕Q2年化317.275万亿韩元上下，HBM结构性需求保留、但经营利润率由Q2约76.3%回落至40–45%。对已大幅下修的跨周期利润给予16–20倍，反映HBM领先和客户粘性溢价，不等于行业一致预期。

bull.rationale: HBM4/4E与服务器存储继续扩量，收入超过当前年化水平26–39%；较高但仍低于Q2的50–55%经营利润率可持续，20–22倍溢价须由长期合同、客户认证和现金回报支持。

limits: Conditional earnings-power valuation, not a guaranteed price or broker consensus. The multiple, revenue, margins, taxes, 12% discount rate and future dilution are explicit researcher assumptions.
No annualization of Q2 reported net income: H1 finance income includes major fair-value gains and investment dividends; they are excluded from normalized profit.

Normalized net interest of +0.35 trillion KRW approximates annualized H1 interest income less expense (0.343960 trillion); no additional net cash, IPO proceeds or investment NAV is added to this equity earnings-power model. It does not separately value nonoperating investment assets; realizable after-tax investment NAV may change a fuller sum-of-parts valuation.

Shares750million are a researcher dilution allowance, not verified October diluted shares; current market capitalization uses the IPO postoffering ordinary-share proxy. SBC is included in assumed operating costs, not added back. Exchangeable bonds reported fully converted at June30 are not also treated as outstanding debt/dilution.

Cash-related88trillionKRW includes financial instruments and investment assets, not just26.836trillion cash; CFO includes13.983648trillion investment dividend receipts and cash taxes below accounting tax expense. Simple FCF is not normalized owner earnings.
Historical/current market NTM Forward P/E has not been independently verified; own 2028 normal-profit multiples must not be labeled market Forward P/E.

No guarantee future capex, maintenance investment or working-capital requirements match earnings. P/E assumes meaningful cross-cycle cash conversion; if capex persistently exceeds depreciation and cash conversion fails, multiples or earnings must be reduced.

FX held at the reference-date rate is a convention, not a forecast. Future dividends/ADS fees/taxes are not included in the displayed price/value gaps. The existing report receives a targeted valuation/financial correction, not a claim of full new company research.
